ValidationRule.description: Restrict Fraud Agents from changing case owner of record types that are not Fraud, Disputes or ANZx Complaints.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId) NOT(ISNEW()), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'FraudX_Agent', NOT( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Fraud' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'KYC_QA' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Identity' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Scam' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Recipient_Mule' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute' , RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Urgent_Dishonour_Request_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ANZx_Complaint' ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not authorised to make this change.
